body_markdown:
Most of the attention in private credit today goes to a handful of headlines, while a far larger market, the financing behind car loans, mortgages, equipment leases, aircraft, and music royalties, quietly keeps getting paid back.


In this video,[Gary Gipkhin](https://www.stepstonegroup.com/members/gary-gipkhin/) and[Tod Trabocco](https://www.stepstonegroup.com/members/tod-trabocco/) from our private debt team explain what specialty credit is and why it is drawing attention now. As regulation pushes banks out of this kind of lending, the borrowers and the assets still need financing, and private capital is stepping in to fill the gap. They also cover the scale of the opportunity and why we believe portfolio construction is critical.


For more on this topic, watch the full video.
